description: New live path for Moonshine Streaming: a dedicated worker hosting the single-thread moonshine-wasm module, fed the recording's 16 kHz frames continuously (not VAD utterances), transcript update interval ~0.3-0.5 s. Map onText -> provisional tokens (replaceProvisional) and onLine -> final tokens with segment-interpolated timing on our sample clock; decide whether its internal VAD replaces Silero for utterance boundaries or we keep our VadSegmenter for speaker windows and only use Moonshine for text (keep one sample clock, see irl-subt-9ij.16). Integrate with LocalEngines load/progress/ModelWarmup, degraded states, WebGPU-free error recovery, and the scheduler (A5). Live harness test with real models. Keep tjs-asr Whisper live path for language=auto.

comments.text: Landed (jj rev 'Live captions stream through Moonshine Streaming'). Design: separate 'stream' engine/worker (moonshine.worker.ts: ms.load w/ warm-up, ms.start, ms.push, ms.stop, ms.transcribe); LocalLiveRun streaming mode feeds ring audio continuously, maps line times from the stream origin, open lines -> provisional tokens (replaceProvisional), completed lines -> final tokens once (deduped host-side), flush on finish. Kept our Silero VadSegmenter for speaker windows/turns (one sample clock); Moonshine's internal VAD only segments lines. Turns no longer wait for text in streaming mode. Harness test 'captions speech live with Moonshine Streaming' (budget first caption < 2.5 s, final p95 < 1.5 s) passes: 1.39 s / 0.77 s. Simulator two_cities Small: load 1171 ms (+58 ms warm-up), interim lag p50/p95 0.31/0.51 s, final 0.50/0.86 s, compute 0.625 per s of new audio, first caption 2.18 s, 63 caption updates. Known: scheduler jumped to level 1 on one pass (rtf 0.99) and disabled interim text for 30 s -> kdl.5. Whisper live path (auto) unchanged.

title: Live STT adapter on moonshine-wasm streaming
